129)༈ang yig sum cu'i snying gtam/dran pas snying gi gdung sel ba/ /pha gcig ngag gi dbang por 'dud/ /rang gis rang la gros su gdab/ /dgon pa'i mgo

tei:div.tei:p: ang yig sum cu'i snying gtam/ dran pas snying gi gdung sel ba// pha gcig ngag gi dbang por 'dud// rang gis rang la gros su gdab// dgon pa'i mgo 'dzin bya 'di yang*// chags zhen rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur pas// gcig pur dben par sdod dang ang*// grong chog sri'u gso 'dre 'dul sogs// zas nor sred pa'i gzhi yin pas// rang sems 'dul la sdod cig ang*// rten gsum bzhengs pa la sogs pa// phal cher dge sdig 'dres ma'i rgyu// rang sems dge la sbyor dang ang*// dbang skur chos bshad 'khor skyong ba/ dngos 'dzin nga rgyal skye ba'i rgyu// blo sna stung la sdod dang ang*// tshong bun 'bul sdud la sogs pa// log 'dod chos brgyad dag gi rgyu// snying nas zhen log sgom cig ang*// mkhon pa bsdum sogs phan pa'i sems// yin snyam phal cher rang 'dod rgyu// re dogs med par sdod dang ang*// mnga' ris 'khor dang longs spyod sogs// 'chi dus phan pa gcig kyang med// rtag tu sgrub la brtson cig ang*// gnyer pa nye gnas la sogs pa// phal cher sems khral 'byung ba'i rgyu// 'du 'dzi thams cad skyungs dang ang*// mkho chas 'dzoms pa'i ri khrod yang*// sdug bsngal 130)rtsod pa'i rgyu yin pas// dgos med rgyud la sbyor dang ang*// 'khor la bka' bkyon bya ba yang*// phan sems yin yang khong khro'i rgyu// tshig 'jam zhi bar smros dang ang*// mtshang brus bden gtam bzang ma ni// snying skran zhe mnag skye ba'i rgyu// snyan snyan yag yag shod dang ang*// chos kyi bgro gleng phal mo che// nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu yin pas// smra bcad gyis la sdod dang ang*// rang gzhan grub mtha'i kha 'dzin yang*/ bstod smad chags sdang dag gi rgyu// thams cad thams cad skyur dang ang*// thos pas bzang ngan shan 'byed yang*// de las rang sdig gsog pa'i rgyu// kun la dag snang sbyongs dang ang*// rgyu 'bras khyad gsod lta sgom yang*// tshogs gnyis nyams len skal ba chad// thabs shes zung 'jug sgom dang ang*// thabs lam phyag rgya bsten pa sogs// phal cher tha mal dngos dang mtshungs// grol lam kho nar 'bungs dang ang*/

khrom dbang skur dang dam rdzas 'grim// phal cher dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu// btsun mgo thon la sdod dang ang*// tho co gcer rgyug byed pa sogs// 'jig rten ma dad skye ba'i rgyu// dran shes bag yod bsten dang ang*// mkhas btsun bzang por rlom na 131)yang*// mthon po'i rtse nas dma' sar ltung*// nyams len thang lhod ma byed ang*// gar bsdad dgos mdza' mi 'tshol zhing*// mi mdza' mi 'khon rang sar gnas// rtag tu rang tshugs zungs dang ang*// yon bdag ngo srung la sogs pa// bdag nyid 'ching ba'i rgyu yin pas// skyid sdug ro snyoms spyod dang ang*// gzo rtsis sman sogs rig gnas yul// bsam gtan gcog pa'i rgyu yin pas// shes bya bskyungs la sdod dang ang*// yid kyi rgyal srid skyong ba yang*// don med mi tshe zad pa'i rgyu// bya byed thams cad shol dang ang*// phyogs re'i yon tan shes na yang*// gang zhen bdag tu 'ching ba'i rgyu// shes bya phyogs med brtson dang ang*// thog ser gtad srung sna tshogs pa// gzhan gnod rang nyid ngan 'gror ltung*// dman sa 'dzin la sdod dang ang*// dpe cha dgos tshad 'dzom na yang*// nyams su ma lon dpes ci bya// sems la blta rtog gyis dang ang*// bstan bcos rtsom dang nyams mgur kun// rnam rtog 'phel ba'i rgyu yin pas// rtag tu blo bral skyongs dang ang*// rnam rtog skyes tshe gcer gyis ltos// sems thag chod dus thog tu zhogasgom du med la sgom pa gces// yengs ba med 132) pa skyongs dang ang*// stong nyid ngang nas rgyu 'bras zhib// byar med rtogs kyang sdom gsum bsrung*// dmigs med snying rjes 'gro phan skyong*// tshogs gnyis dbyer med sgom dang ang*// ang yig sum cu'i snying gtam 'di// kun mkhyen bla ma'i zhal lung yin// rang gi rgyud la sbyor cig ang*// dpe 'di su la bri ma bcol// dpe ngan rgyun 'byams bstan bshig yin// dgos na kun mkhyen gsung rab bris//
rang gi rang la gros su gdab pa'i ang yig sum cu pa pad nor pas bris/ dge'o//
